content.value_statement: Teams can miss usability issues when reviewing features from an internal perspective. This skill guides persona-based testing with Aftrac and Sirius customer viewpoints.
actual_capabilities: Applies Aftrac and Sirius customer personas to feature reviews.
Guides reviews of first login, document upload, checklists, reports, and certificate expiry.
Supports consultant scenarios such as demos, onboarding, evidence search, multi-client views, and audit preparation.
Structures feedback into impressions, positives, friction points, missing features, recommendations, and persona quotes.
Lists companion Aftrac and Sirius persona agents for optional deeper context.
limitations: Only the SKILL.md instructions are present in this package.
Persona feedback is simulated and should be checked with real users.
It does not automate browser actions or collect analytics by itself.
It is tailored to LogiDocs Certify and may need adaptation for other products.

use_cases.title: Pre-release feature review
use_cases.description: Review a new LogiDocs Certify feature through Aftrac to find clarity gaps before release.

use_cases.title: Consultant workflow validation
use_cases.description: Use the Sirius persona to assess speed, credibility, and client-management fit for consultant workflows.

use_cases.title: Demo readiness check
use_cases.description: Simulate customer reactions before a sales or onboarding demo and capture likely questions.

prompt_templates.title: Review one screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single feature or page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the [feature or page] from Aftrac perspective. Identify first impressions, friction points, and one priority improvement.

prompt_templates.title: Compare persona reactions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate comparison across both customer types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare how Aftrac and Sirius would react to [feature]. Focus on clarity, trust, workflow speed, and missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Test a full workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured evaluation of a multi-step user journey.
prompt_templates.prompt: As Sirius, test the [workflow name] flow. Report where a consultant gains time, loses confidence, or needs stronger evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Create a readiness report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release review with prioritized recommendations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a persona testing report for [release area] using Aftrac and Sirius. Include positives, friction points, missing features, and prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: Review the documents page as Aftrac.
output: Aftrac notices upload actions first but may need clearer guidance on required certificates.
The main friction is knowing which document matters most for CE or UKCA readiness.
Recommended fix: add a visible next-step indicator for incomplete supplier evidence.

output_examples.input: Would Sirius recommend the signup flow to clients?
output: Sirius would look for trust signals, setup speed, and evidence that client separation is handled well.
The recommendation depends on whether onboarding explains multi-client management early.

output_examples.input: Test audit preparation for a consultant user.
output: The review checks evidence search, report clarity, and support for ISO surveillance preparation.
A strong result shows fast retrieval of management review evidence and clear client-ready summaries.

best_practices: Name the persona, feature, and workflow stage before asking for feedback.
Ask for both friction points and positive observations to avoid one-sided reviews.
Convert persona feedback into prioritized product changes after each review.
anti_patterns: Do not treat simulated feedback as a replacement for real customer research.
Do not ask for generic UX feedback without naming a persona or scenario.
Do not use the same persona for every workflow when the user roles differ.

faq.question: What does this skill test?
faq.answer: It tests LogiDocs Certify features from Aftrac and Sirius customer perspectives.

faq.question: Does it perform automated browser testing?
faq.answer: No. It provides persona-based review guidance and structured feedback prompts.

faq.question: Which personas are included?
faq.answer: It includes Aftrac as an end user and Sirius as a consultant persona.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a persona testing report with impressions, positives, friction points, missing features, and recommendations.

faq.question: Is the feedback real customer evidence?
faq.answer: No. It is simulated feedback and should be validated with real customer interviews or usability tests.
